reviews.text: Bipin is the most amazing, knowledgeable and caring Vet. We took our Greyhound and he was able to establish very quickly why she had developed a limp. He has treated her and gave us the relevant medication and she is on the road to recovery. His fees are very reasonable and the service we received was excellent. I can’t thank him enough. Highly recommended. Thank you Bipin.

Mr. Kothari and his assistant Anna have been consistently caring and humane in the way they have treated my beloved golden retriever Sophie over the past few years.
Our family were so sad to have to make the decision to put her to sleep recently, but their gentle approach and guidance made the experience as positive as it could be under the circumstances.
Would highly recommend.
Best vets I have been to

I have used this surgery for all my cats since 2002. My cats have always received the highest professional care. There have been many dramas to deal with over the years with the cats I have/have had, and the team (Bipinchandra Kothari and Anna) have always done whatever it takes to get my fur babies back to optimal health with minimum fuss. I wouldn't go anywhere else.
A very good Vet service indeed! Top people, very much care about the health of your pets and provide a good service. Will use again!

I was a bit hesitant at getting my cat neutered here after reading the bad reviews but as a lot of my family have used this vet for years and have never had any problems I took him anyway and I’m glad. both the vet and the receptionist were friendly and polite the vet handled my cat gently there have been no problems and we will definitely be using them again thank you

Thank you to all at the practice for the care and support they gave me and my lovely cat Chukky !
It was so appreciated and I wish the outcome would have been better but sadly I had to say goodbye.
Many thanks to everyone involved.

All the best!

Im so glad to have gone to this Vets today. After getting totally ripped off from a chain vet in meanwood (yorkshire vets) I was very impressed with the old school honesty and advice of Bipin and his assistant Anna. My cat has had a weeping eye for some time.  I was not only reassured about his eye but was given a full diagnosis and advised on all possible outcomes and options.  The way Bipin checked my cats body was so professional my cat did not meow or cry out once. I also asked about flea and malting. I was not sold products, in fact,  I was advised on how to get the best flea and hair malting products online at a cheaper price.  The honesty, advice and integrity of this vet was truly a breath of fresh air. Highly recommend if you want an honest vet who's been going 50 years and clearly cares about animals and their owners.  Thank you so much!!! ❤️
Lovely local vet excellent value for money, very caring team

This Place is a Death Trap for Pets

This is not a veterinary clinic—it is a dangerous, unsanitary backroom operation run by a man who is completely unfit to perform surgery. The clinic is filthy, disorganized, and unsafe, with a serious risk of infection due to the lack of cleanliness and sterilization.

Bipinchandra Kothari is old, visibly shaking, and reckless. His hands are too unsteady to perform surgery safely, yet he continues to operate. To make matters worse, he allows his receptionist, Anna, to assist in procedures, even though she has no medical qualifications.

There is no proper record-keeping, no accountability, and no concern for the animals’ well-being. If you love your pet, do not bring them here.

Thank you so much!.
We feel so lucky to have this vet!.... One of the few independent vets that remain despite the buldozer of corporate culture and the immoral prices that go with that. Lovely caring people and warm skillful service. Thanks again.

Always looking after my cat, brilliant service.

We’ve been with Oakwood Vets for well over 15 years and they looked after both our cats that have now sadly passed away. We have nothing but praise for the team. Our cats received expert care for many years and we cannot thank them enough for the compassion shown when our eldest cat passed away earlier this year. I have recommended Oakwood Vets to others and will continue to do so.
